description: A light wood cabinet with glass doors and two drawers. The cabinet has two shelves within the glass-fronted section, divided by a vertical wooden support. The lower section features two drawers, each with a simple horizontal handle. The cabinet is supported by four angled legs, giving it a slightly retro or mid-century modern feel. The wood grain is visible and appears to be a light-colored hardwood, possibly oak or pine. The overall design is clean and functional, suitable for displaying items or for storage.
